5:18.text: All this is from God, who through Christ reconciled us to himself and gave us the ministry of reconciliation;

5:19.text: that is, in Christ God was reconciling the world to himself, not counting their trespasses against them, and entrusting to us the message of reconciliation.

5:21.text: For our sake he made him to be sin who knew no sin, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
